text.text_excerpt: PJ's has been my go to for the past couple of weeks for me to catch up on paperwork and grab a nice cup of joe. The ladies that has been working there in the AM are very pleasant and work very fast. You can see people come in and stay no longer than 4-5 minutes. They are very accommodating to many orders as many people have special requests throughout. I don't mind this place since there is a new Starbucks opened in the area as it is less crowded and less noisy to do work. I would recommend anybody to utilize this location for business and/or coffee.

The employees at this PJ's are amazing. Sometimes my life requires that I consume massive amounts of caffeine twice a day. I normally stop on my way to work, then again mid day. It's those mid-day stops that bring me to this PJ's and help me survive the day. Located in what I remember as Aurora Village, this shopping area bears almost no similarities to the 1980s or 90s versions I remember from growing up. In fact, PJ's is located now around where Godfather's Pizza or the road leading to the Movie Theater would've been back then. That may not mean much to any of you who are reading this so I'll move on. PJ's is located in a kind of out of the way spot from where it used to be. In fact, ha...

Pretty good PJ's with nice booths and free WiFi if you have work to do. I stopped in here to get my usual iced coffee and it was the usual good PJ's coffee that I really like. My one complaint about the place is they wouldn't honor a coupon I had. They explained that the coupon could only be honored at certain locations, but there was nothing on the coupon that said that- it just said I could use it at any PJ's location. Anyway, I went to my regular PJ's a few days later and they not only honored the coupon, but they told me that it can be honored at any PJ's and the folks at this place screwed up.
